moments.text: Digital recreation fades in from black: a dark mountain silhouette with a bright orange glow behind its peaks and tiny lights along its base.
Small red dots enter from the right edge one after another, forming a spaced row in the sky as the orange glow fades.
The row of red dots drifts left across the peaks and closes up into four evenly spaced dots above the left summit.
The view dissolves into a closer mountain scene; four red dots stay in the sky right of centre.
As a jagged rock face fades in on the left, a single orange light shows at the left edge.
Another dissolve: two orange lights, one up and left of the other, glow against the rock face; two red dots linger at the right edge.
The scene darkens, the two orange lights fade, and the picture goes to black at 0:19.5.
